from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompletionRecord(BaseModel):
    """A monthly housing completion count for a specific region/total, extracted from a document."""
    month: str = Field(description="Month in YYYY-MM format, e.g., '2022-08'")
    region: str = Field(description="Geographic region identifier (e.g., 'United States', 'Northeast', 'Midwest', 'South', 'West')")
    value: float = Field(description="Number of New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed (Not Seasonally Adjusted)")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="Release date of the report this value comes from, YYYY-MM-DD")
    source_doc_id: int = Field(description="Integer ID of the source document in the collection (e.g., 1, 2, 34)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    records: list[CompletionRecord] = Field(description="All extracted monthly housing completion records from the document collection")
